body.label: Target
body.html: Self or an adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: A melee Action would push or pull the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that forced movement by 2 units.

surges.html: The target also reduces Damage from that Action by 1.
After the Action, move its attacker 1 unit away from the protected creature if adjacent to you; compare your Success Die to its Fortitude.
